newsitem.title: USA: AMEX plans CYTYC, Premiere options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX plans CYTYC, Premiere options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said it will list options on shares of CYTYC Corp and Premiere Technologies Inc on December 4.
CYTYC options will have initial strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30, with expirations in December, January, February and May, the exchange said. Charlton, Goin, SLK will be the specialist unit.

Premiere Technologies options will open with strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. Initial expiration months will be December, January, February and May, AMEX said. Group One Trading LP will be the specialist unit.
